summary.text: Alan Thomas is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 50, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Bill Morris.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Thomas described himself as a Birmingham native and said he has worked in investigative journalism and policy research.

paragraphs.text: Thomas said in a Ballotpedia survey that he graduated from the Altamont School, attended Auburn University and pursued graduate studies at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
He described himself as a father and husband and said he is running as a Democrat who believes in fiscal responsibility.
Thomas was unopposed for the Democratic nomination, as the District 50 primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.

He listed individual rights, including rights to speak, associate, worship and bear arms, as his main campaign message, and named energy, environment, health and mental health care, criminal justice, constitutional rights and small business as policy areas he cares about.
